notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed. The package serves LineFollower-v0 (gym_line_follower.envs:LineFollowerEnv); the fake backend is a pure Python kinematic unicycle on a fixed circular track, not the upstream PyBullet environment, and it was not compared with upstream (the upstream package and gym, pybullet, opencv-python and shapely are not available where the gate ran; numpy is present but the fake does not use it; nothing was pip-installed). The upstream simulator path (gym.make('LineFollower-v0')) was not run; the fake is level F0 and its fidelity gaps state the missing dynamics, random track generation, camera-window observation geometry and RNG difference. NOT COVERED: the 240 x 320 x 3 camera observation of LineFollowerCamera-v0 (the driver wraps the points_latch environment; the camera subclass is cited in facts but not served). Five warnings are expected from the Gymnasium family bridge: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed is stored for the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT (integer reset/seed inputs, ticks, and the simulator's action.values). Only catalogue classes cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1 and cap.world.step.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests and no extension ids. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
